title_text: BRING ME THE HEAD OF ANTONIO MAYANS
credits_text: A short film by Felipe M. Guerra
other_text: Actor Antonio Mayans made more than 150 films. Some were good, some were really bad. And now... the worst of them could be his death sentence.
moderation_notes: Contains implied violence with a gun.
